dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: What brought you in today, and have you checked your blood pressure recently?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have had a heavy pressure feeling in my head since yesterday. I checked my blood pressure at home this morning and it was one hundred sixty eight over one hundred two.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: That is quite high. Are you currently taking medicine for high blood pressure?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I normally take amlodipine every morning.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you been taking the amlodipine regularly during the last week?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Not completely. I missed my dose yesterday and I think I also forgot it two days before that.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had chest pain, shortness of breath, blurred vision, weakness, or numbness?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No chest pain and my breathing feels normal. My vision is normal too, and I have not noticed any weakness or numbness.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you taken today's dose of amlodipine?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I took it this morning after I measured the high blood pressure.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: All right. We will repeat your blood pressure here, examine you, and decide whether your treatment needs to be adjusted.
